sessionStart.powershell: $bash=Get-Command bash.exe -All -CommandType Application | Where-Object { Test-Path (Join-Path (Split-Path $_.Source -Parent) 'git.exe') } | Select-Object -First 1; if ($null -eq $bash) { throw 'Git Bash bash.exe not found' }; & $bash.Source -lc 'bin/fm-copilot-hook.sh session-start'
